edit_summary: Replaced Q18 #pragma omp atomic with thread-local hash map accumulation; parallelized Q21 finalize inner loop with OpenMP.
expected_improvement: ~15-25% batch total reduction from eliminating atomic contention (~60M CAS ops) and parallelizing Q21 finalize
rationale: Q18 atomic on every lineitem row was the single worst hotspot inside the fused scan. Q21 finalize was the largest finalization cost.
